Feature / Surface: exec marker leak / lost exit code
User Story: (defect) Command output without trailing newline corrupts exec result
Expected Behaviour: Exec output must never contain internal NOID_EXEC markers and must always report the real exit code.
Test Result / Notes: Fix: exec wrapper now emits the exit marker via printf with a LEADING newline (extracted to wrap_command()), guaranteeing the marker is on its own line; $? still captures the command's exit. Added 3 regression unit tests. Verified e2e on a rebuilt isolated server: no leaks, exit codes correct. crates/noid-core/src/exec.rs.

User Story: (defect) Operator restarting the server destroys all microVMs
Expected Behaviour: Restarting noid-server should leave running Firecracker VMs alive.
Test Result / Notes: Fix: scripts/noid-server.service now sets KillMode=process so only the main server proc is signaled, leaving FC VM children alive. Mechanism proven via transient systemd-run test (child survived service stop). NOT applied to the live host (no passwordless sudo here, and a restart could disrupt base1/base2 if applied incorrectly). To apply: copy unit to /etc/systemd/system + 'systemctl daemon-reload' (no restart needed; takes effect next restart).

Feature / Surface: destroy of absent VM reports success
User Story: (defect) Misleading 'destroyed' message
Expected Behaviour: Destroying a nonexistent VM should not claim it was destroyed.
Test Result / Notes: Idempotent DELETE returns 204 with no exists/absent signal; client prints 'destroyed'. Low priority; standard REST idempotency. Documented, not fixed.
